channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Rockstar releases GTA VI's final trailer ahead of its November 19 launch
item.description: The last trailer before launch focuses on Jason and Lucia, with a new Justice song and plenty of explosions.

item.title: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo foldable opens for preorders today
item.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone can be ordered from October 16 and goes on sale October 23.

item.title: Anthropic's quarterly revenue is reported at $16.8 billion, up 50%
item.description: The Financial Times reports Anthropic's third-quarter revenue rose about 50% from the previous quarter as it prepares for a possible IPO.

item.title: Street Fighter opens today, tracking for a $70 million global start
item.description: Paramount and Legendary's live-action film is forecast at $25 to $35 million in the US and about $70 million worldwide.

item.title: FTC sends OpenAI and Anthropic 50-page demands for safety records
item.description: The US consumer watchdog wants records on security incidents, safeguards, marketing and privacy from both AI labs, Axios reports.

item.title: Anthropic is reported to pitch investors on an IPO worth up to $2 trillion
item.description: Anthropic met institutional investors in San Francisco ahead of a listing reportedly targeted before Thanksgiving.

item.title: Epic delays its Marvel and Star Wars shooter as it goes AI-first
item.description: Bloomberg reports an internal email told staff 'no more hand-written code' and that art would come from AI workflows.

item.title: TSMC posts record quarter as AI chip demand lifts profit 69%
item.description: The world's biggest chipmaker earned $46.7 billion in third-quarter revenue and guided higher for the fourth.

item.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT and child safety
item.description: State attorneys general filed separate lawsuits alleging ChatGPT harmed minors despite being marketed as safe.

item.title: Peacock's Friday the 13th prequel Crystal Lake drops all episodes
item.description: Linda Cardellini plays Pamela Voorhees in the series, which critics call the franchise's best-reviewed entry.

item.title: Nintendo shows five minutes of its Ocarina of Time remake
item.description: The Switch 2 remake adds a boss-rematch area and arrives on November 5.

item.title: Apple is reported to unveil a touchscreen MacBook Pro in late October
item.description: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports a two-day Los Angeles showcase on October 27 and 28.

item.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could soon spread across smart devices
item.description: Anthropic research says small models could copy themselves across TVs and appliances within months if progress continues.

item.title: Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes documentary opens in theaters
item.description: You Can See Everything, by Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, follows Holmes in the month before she went to prison.

item.title: Dell falls 11% as an analyst downgrade deepens an AI hardware selloff
item.description: Barclays said Dell's growth reflects memory costs more than AI demand, pulling HPE, Oracle and CoreWeave lower.

item.title: DeepSeek is reported to be near a $14 billion funding round
item.description: The Chinese AI lab is said to be finishing a 100-billion-yuan round at a 500-billion-yuan valuation, double its original target.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4's campaign early access starts today
item.description: Digital pre-order buyers can play the campaign a week before the October 23 launch on PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2.

item.title: Researchers say an ad network was used to deliver Candiru spyware
item.description: Citizen Lab and Confiant tied Israeli ad agency Discover-Tech to malicious ads that infected targets' devices.

item.title: Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open model with a 1M-token window
item.description: Nvidia's new 120-billion-parameter open model ships with weights, datasets and training recipes.

item.title: CoreWeave shares slide as its bond yields touch 15%
item.description: The AI cloud company's stock fell sharply as investors worried about the debt behind the AI data center boom.

item.title: Whalefall, about a diver swallowed by a whale, opens to solid reviews
item.description: Brian Duffield's survival thriller opens October 16 with 79% on Rotten Tomatoes.

item.title: Asus's $1,299 ROG Xbox Ally X20 handheld goes on sale
item.description: The OLED handheld gaming PC with Xbox branding launched on October 15.

item.title: Zendaya joins Alex Garland's next sci-fi film at A24
item.description: The untitled film, with plot under wraps, is set to shoot next year, Variety reports.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is out after strong reviews
item.description: Konami's new 2D Castlevania launched October 15 for $29.99, with an 86 Metacritic score reported before launch.

item.title: Justice confirmed as composer of GTA VI's score as final trailer song lands
item.description: The French duo's new track, featuring Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard, soundtracks the game's last trailer.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance gets 36 out of 40 in its first review
item.description: Famitsu's reviewers scored Square Enix's new RPG highly ahead of its October 22 release.

item.title: OpenAI agrees not to use disputed files while Apple's lawsuit proceeds
item.description: OpenAI denies Apple's trade-secret claims but agreed to hold off using the disputed information, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to fix flaws found by Claude Mythos
item.description: The bank's CEO said Anthropic's model surfaced so many software issues that it added contractors to patch them.

item.title: Clayface premiere reactions call it a gruesome body horror throwback
item.description: DC's horror spin on the Batman villain opens next week, and Matt Reeves explained how it fits the DC universe.

item.title: Google widens Gemini 4 Argon to subscribers and businesses
item.description: Google's new flagship model is rolling out to AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, enterprises and paid developers.

item.title: OpenAI recorder case: prosecutors say a linked chatbot account asked how to build bugs
item.description: New details say an account tied to the charged engineer asked about hidden audio recorders days before the device was planted.

item.title: White House AI task force adopts its charter and starts a 120-day clock
item.description: A federal group on frontier AI will prepare a report on managing advanced AI development within 120 days.

item.title: Jason Statham returns in the first Beekeeper 2 teaser
item.description: Amazon MGM's sequel, directed by Timo Tjahjanto, opens in cinemas on January 15.

item.title: Netflix drops The Diplomat season 4 and Victorious spin-off Hollywood Arts
item.description: Both series arrived in full on October 15, alongside ABC's 9-1-1 and Grey's Anatomy premieres.

item.title: Survey finds attackers used AI in most ransomware attacks
item.description: A Semperis survey found 84% of organizations hit by ransomware said attackers used AI somewhere in the attack.

item.title: Microsoft unveils the $49.99 Xbox Nano, a pocket-sized controller
item.description: The smallest Xbox controller yet is just over five inches long and ships in select markets in November.

item.title: Indie hit Peak climbs onto consoles this month
item.description: The co-op climbing game will launch on consoles with all the updates and content released so far.

item.title: Cohere plans to buy AI security startup AISLE
item.description: The Canadian AI company signed a letter of intent to acquire AISLE and form a new Cohere Cyber unit.

item.title: Bluesky opens its Attie app so anyone can build sites and games with AI
item.description: Users can now make websites, quizzes, polls and small games tied to their Bluesky identity.

item.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave gets a three-wave expansion pass
item.description: Nintendo's pass adds weapons now, new allies this holiday season and new stories in 2027.
